d: The Celtics defeated the Wizards, 131-116 tonight in Washington. Jayson Tatum contributed a team-high 41 points to go with 8 assists 6 rebounds and 6 three pointers, with Paul George of the Celtics adding an additional 28 points (11-20 FG, 6-9 3P) in the game. Anthony Davis finished with a team-high 33 points along with 13 rebounds for the Wizards in the losing effort. The Celtics improve their record to 12-6 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 7-12 for the season.
